description: Pixel-precise comparison of two PNG buffers of identical dimensions. Returns differing-pixel count, MAE per channel, ΔE94 mean/max/p95 (CIE perceptual colour distance), Sobel-edge delta, and SSIM. Inputs are file paths (sandbox-relative).
name: compare_images
title: Compare two PNGs (MAE / ΔE94 / Sobel-edge / SSIM)
